entities.summary: Estonia is a sovereign nation in Northern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Tallinn. Official languages include Estonian. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 1.4 million. Area: 45,339 km². Comprehensive index for Estonia covering Finno-Ugric settlement (one of oldest European peoples), Northern Crusades (Livonian Crusade 1208-27, Christianisation by force), Terra Mariana (Livonian Confederation), Teutonic Order/Livonian Order rule, Danish Estonia (Tallinn = Danish town), Swedish rule 1561-1710 ('good old Swedish time'), Russian Empire (Great Northern War, Peter the Great), Baltic German nobility, national awakening (Song Festival movement 1869), Estonian independence 1918-40, Soviet occupation 1940/1944-91, Nazi occupation 1941-44, Singing Revolution 1988, independence restored 1991, digital society (e-Estonia), NATO/EU 2004.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Estonia's national awakening in the late 19th century led to the establishment of the Song Festival movement, which played a crucial role in the country's struggle for independence. The Singing Revolution of 1988 marked a pivotal moment in Estonia's transition from Soviet occupation to independence.
